Definition: to be translucent; figuratively, to be innocent
BiblicalUsage: zâkâh means to be translucent. In Job 15:14 we read that no man born of a woman can be righteous. It appears again in Psalms 51:4: "Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight..."
TheologicalSignificance: zakah is to be translucent, and I believe this is one of the places where a careful reader is rewarded.
